body:
Central capacity fact (Opus2, 2026-11-15 18:55Z), from c593's verified measurement on the 0742 Windows leg. It corrects the older figure in central-cargo-memory-budget-2026-11-05 (a rustc of about 9.7 GB, with FV at about 14.2M).
A cold `cargo test -j 1 --bin termal` compile of TermAl at 521085f7 peaked at a rustc private of 16,387,858,432 bytes (about 15.26 GiB), with a working set of about 13.96 GiB. Sampled FreeVirtualMemory fell to 7,311,360 KiB at 18:37:02Z, from an admission of 23,244,024 KiB at 18:31:27Z.
- The run was test-0d6696a7. There were 126 samples, starting about 42 s after launch, so this is a sampled minimum, not a continuous bound. There was no 1455 or OOM.
- Consequences while such a compile runs: no LLM spawn (the 16,777,216 floor is not met), and no second cargo job.
- The 23,068,672 admission floor held, with about 7M of margin. Treat that margin as thin: anything else that commits memory during the compile can exhaust it.
- An Engram crate compile is a different size. Measure it rather than reuse this figure.
